checkpoint.title: Magikarp seen: MIMIEN to the PC, a Magikarp bought at the Route 4 Pokemon Center

events.why: Out of the Dept. Store by the west door, to fly.
The Route 4 Pokemon Center: its PC and the Magikarp salesman.
Below the Center's PC, facing it.
MIMIEN still points at the leaked mail record 0, so Retro Mail given to it opens that record, not the ? Mail. Out of the party, it leaves a slot for a member whose mail index is 0xFF (the Magikarp).
"Would you like to buy a MAGIKARP for just $500?" (pret Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScript_MagikarpSalesman).
YES: $500, Magikarp Lv 5 joins the party in slot 6, seen and caught in the Pokedex.
The salesman's last line, back to free control.

metadata.notes: Starts where frlg.mail_glitch's 08-activate-and-verify ends (Celadon Dept. Store 1F (6, 2), the save spot frlg.supplies and frlg.team_training start from). The Post-E4 ACE route (pomeg-letterbombers' FRLG non-JPN Post-E4 route) needs Magikarp seen for its fourth word, and on the save 08 leaves it is not (Gyarados is). The salesman is the cheapest way: $500, one talk, no rod and no battle. The ? Mail opens on mail[0xFF] only for a member whose mail index is 0xFF while all six party mail records are taken (the leaked record 0 and the five filler mails): MIMIEN's index is 0, so MIMIEN goes to the PC and the Magikarp, with no mail, takes slot 6. Depositing MIMIEN also ends its stale index 0: later item duplication gives mail to a 0xFF member and reads the ? Mail's words, not ABRA.
